message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city.
They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses.
The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family.
They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff.
The forest watched from the trees.
The wind moved through the pines.
The path bent toward the market.
The bells rang at noon.
The river ran below the bridge.
The stone kept its old warmth.
The children pointed at the roofs.
The merchants carried fresh bread.
The lamp burned in the window.
The horse waited by the gate.
The rain tapped the slate.
The cat curled on the sill.
The baker measured the flour.
The elder read the old names.
The song rose from the hall.
The light gathered on the wall.
The door opened with care.
The table showed many meals.
The night came softly down.
The old housekeeper finally arrived at the quiet village in the morning with a basket, a map, a lantern, a small dog, a warm coat, a gentle cat, a soft blanket, and a bright spotty smile.
